title: Feedback checks · fbk
summary: Ten five-node sentinel lymph node cases from the public CAMELYON17 data set, two per pN category, for practice reports.
practiceStatement: Practice report on public de-identified teaching cases. Not a diagnostic or sign-out tool.
useNotice: Your programme may ask you to send the exported results file for curriculum and programme evaluation; sending it is your choice, and the file contains only what you typed and did.

attribution.holder: Computational Pathology Group, Radboud University Medical Center, Nijmegen, with Canisius-Wilhelmina Hospital, UMC Utrecht, Rijnstate Hospital and LabPON
attribution.sentence: CAMELYON17 data set by the Computational Pathology Group, Radboud University Medical Center, Nijmegen, with Canisius-Wilhelmina Hospital, UMC Utrecht, Rijnstate Hospital and LabPON (CC0 1.0). Slides are read directly from the dataset's public bucket; nothing is copied or uploaded.
attribution.citation: Bandi P, Geessink O, Manson Q, et al. From detection of individual metastases to classification of lymph node status at the patient level: the CAMELYON17 challenge. IEEE Trans Med Imaging 2019;38(2):550–560. doi:10.1109/TMI.2018.2867350.
